name: Qwen3-1.7B Dual-H100 ORPO Training Optimization v4 — Cross Matrix

work.agent_query: Read AGENT_TASK.md and optimize the supplied full-parameter BF16 Qwen3-1.7B ORPO training step on two CUDA GPUs (compute capability 8.0 or newer, at least 60 GiB each, NCCL). Preserve the initialized solution, implement build_objective and optionally build_model_patch according to runtime.api, use the public tests for development, record retained experiments, and leave FINAL_VERSION on the strongest validated version.

dual-cuda-sm80-60g-nccl.interconnect: NCCL over any CUDA peer transport (NVLink used for qualification; a non-NVLink pair is admitted with scripts/preflight.py --allow-non-nvlink)
dual-cuda-sm80-60g-nccl.notes: Capability envelope enforced by the trusted runtime (orpo_lab/runtime/distributed_probe.py) and by the Judge controller (e2e_formal_controller.py); GPU model, UUID, clocks and the qualification peak-memory bytes are recorded as measurement provenance only. The 60 GiB floor covers the largest scored workload with headroom; 40 GiB and 48 GiB cards do not fit.

primary.notes: The score is a ratio against the official TRL reference, which is re-measured live on whatever devices ran the candidate; it carries no frozen device constant. Absolute throughput (tokens/s) behind the ratio is comparable only within one measurement profile.
